# Problem types

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-openapi.ts from server/problem-types.js. Do not edit; run `npm run api:openapi`. -->

Every error under `/api/v2` is `application/problem+json` ([RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457)). The `type` is the identifier URL below; clients must not depend on it resolving.

| Slug | Status | Title | Used for |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `validation_error` | 400 | Invalid request | body, query or header failed its schema; `errors[]` lists the issues |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | Unauthorized | no token or a bad token; sends `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` |
| `forbidden` | 403 | Forbidden | the verified user may not do this |
| `not_found` | 404 | Not found | unknown path or resource |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | Method not allowed | the path exists for other methods; sets `Allow` |
| `not_acceptable` | 406 | Not acceptable | `Accept` cannot be satisfied |
| `conflict` | 409 | Conflict | state conflict (for example a reused idempotency key with another body) |
| `payload_too_large` | 413 | Payload too large | JSON body over 1 MiB |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 | Unsupported media type | a body that is not `application/json` |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests | rate limit hit; carries `retryAfter` and `Retry-After` |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Internal error | unexpected exception |
| `not_enabled` | 501 | Feature not enabled | the route needs a binding or secret this deployment does not have; carries `feature` |
| `bad_gateway` | 502 | Bad gateway | the DualMind API is unreachable or answered nonsense |
| `gateway_timeout` | 504 | Gateway timeout | the DualMind API did not answer in time |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Service unavailable | the v2 router could not be loaded (answered by worker.js) |

Identifier URL: `https://arena.dualmindlab.tech/problems/<slug>`.
